parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical with a horizontal lever.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water, typically for hot or cold water depending on installation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its vertical axis to open or close the water flow.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical with a horizontal lever.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water, typically for the opposite temperature side of the right handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its vertical axis to open or close the water flow.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, curved to direct water flow downward.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers water from the faucet body to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally depending on the faucet design, but typically remains fixed.

parts.name: Frame (Base of Spout)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the spout, made of stainless steel, circular and flat.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and seals the spout to the sink surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Right Handle Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the right handle, made of stainless steel, cylindrical and fixed to the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the right handle and connects it to the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during handle operation.

parts.name: Frame (Left Handle Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the left handle, made of stainless steel, cylindrical and fixed to the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the left handle and connects it to the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during handle operation.
